item.description: - Company & Economy Analysis: Pull one public company's most recent quarterly cash flow statement, write down net income, operating cash flow, and the dollar gap, then identify which single line item, receivables, payables, or a non-cash add-back, explains most of it. - Financial Planning Facts: Pull one incorporated client's prior year T2, find their adjusted aggregate investment income, and calculate their reduced small business limit for this year using the $5-per-$1 grind above $50,000. - Communication: Take one analogy you use often in client meetings and write out, in one sentence, what relationship it is supposed to map.
